what: How accuracy is scored again in rescore.py. Read off the item audit of the LiveNerf authors, for the 78 questions of this experiment.
audit_file: data/item_audit.tsv of the LiveNerf repository, commit 3febff6 (series day 47, 2026-11-09)

why.mmlupro-8931: Ambiguous in the audit. Options B and G list the same two eigenvalues, 1 and 6. G is keyed.
why.mmlupro-4659: Ambiguous in the audit. Options A and J are the same value in different units (1.88e-5 m3 atm = 1.905 J). A is keyed.
why.mmlupro-11036: Ambiguous in the audit. Options B and C are logically equivalent. B is keyed.
why.mmlupro-1261: Ambiguous in the audit. Options G and H state the same rule. G is keyed.
why.mmlupro-3797: Key suspect in the audit. With 15.3 dpm/g and a 5,730-year half-life the age is about 6,950 years, option G. The keyed B (6,225 years) follows from about 14 dpm/g. The question gives neither figure.
why.mmlupro-4342: Key suspect in the audit. The question as written gives 7.16 - 4.14 = 3.02 ppm, option I. The keyed E adds instead, which is where trifluoroacetic acid is found in practice.
why.mmlupro-3000: Key suspect in the audit. Option J is the textbook definition of a competitive inhibitor. I is keyed.
why.comps-cmimc_2025-07: Key suspect in the audit. Brute force of the stated recursion gives 932 and the key is 930 (two implementations by the auditor, a third by us).
why.mmlupro-574: Key suspect in the audit. 1.90 / 0.09 = 21.11 is not an option. The key is 22.11.
why.mmlupro-9908: Key suspect in the audit. A 0.5% contraction of brass needs about 260 K of cooling. No option is near it.
why.gpqa-recN4DY9Q5V03glmQ: Key suspect in the audit. The key matches a non-relativistic momentum only. The relativistic value matches no option.
why.mmlupro-9873: Key suspect in the audit. Its note names an unkeyed option that fits and says several other options fit as well.
